title: Combined Cannabidiol and Δ9-Tetrahydrocannabinol Modulate Inflammation and Nociceptive Signaling in Human Dental Pulp Cells
html: Dental pulp inflammation, caused by caries, trauma, or restorative operations, produces pain and slows regeneration. Cannabidiol (CBD) and Δ9-tetrahydrocannabinol (THC), cannabinoids of Cannabis sativa, have effects on inflammation and pain relief. However, the impact of these factors on dental pulp healing is not yet understood. This study investigated the combined effects of CBD and THC in controlling inflammation and nociception during dental pulp repair.
